properties.description: A source on an ET reputation list (CINS, Spamhaus DROP, known compromised hosts) logs in to Cowrie within the same hour as Suricata flags it. The lists alone fire on a hundred-odd addresses a day, mostly probing database ports; joining them to a successful login keeps the few that got a shell. Buckets are fixed hours, so a pair that straddles a boundary is missed.
